cohort: 14,414 mother-infant dyads from the UK Millennium Cohort Study
finding: While planned C-section was associated with lower odds of breastfeeding initiation, both planned and unplanned C-sections were associated with shorter durations of any and exclusive breastfeeding compared to vaginal births.
mod_finding: Both planned and unplanned C-sections were associated with shorter durations of any and exclusive breastfeeding compared to vaginal births.
